name: search_mathlib
description: Search the pinned mathlib Lean source using a regular expression; at most 100 lines.

name: read_mathlib
description: Read specified lines of a Mathlib/*.lean source file from the pinned checkout.

name: check_transition
description: Compile a tactic body for the fixed target; no leading by, declarations, or placeholders.

name: submit_transition
description: Submit and check the final tactic body for the same target.

name: check_auxiliary
description: Compile one helper proposition and tactic body in exactly this local port context. This never accepts the final goal or adds a premise.

name: read_lean_draft
description: Read only your own same-stage proof/helper attempts. kind=index lists attempts; proof/auxiliary returns the selected body lines and actual check. No other stage or file is accessible.

name: read_background_note
description: Read one complete audited background note from this task index by its qualified ID. No other task, file or proof is accessible; this is guidance, not a checked Lean proof.
